senses.gloss: गुग्गुल m. (-लः) A gum resin: see the next.

गुग्गुलु m. (-लुः)
 1. A fragrant gum resin, Bdellium or the exudation of
the Amyris agallochum.
 2. A species of morunga, (M. hyperanthe-
ra.)
 E. गुज् (here said to mean) disease, and गुड to perfume, affixes
क and उ, ड change to ल; also गुग्गुल.
